glossary.definition: (A) "Conduct the business" means engaging in activities regulated under sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Corrupt activity" has the same meaning as in section 2923 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Knowingly" has the same meaning as in section 2901.22 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.definition: (D) "Material" means a statement or omission that can affect the course or outcome of a transaction, regardless of whether or not the person making the statement or omission believes it to be material. "Material" includes the furnishing of a false or erroneous name, address, taxpayer identification number, business, profession, or occupation and the displaying or otherwise producing of physical proof of this false information.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.definition: (E) "Money" means a medium of exchange that is authorized or adopted by a domestic or foreign government as a part of its currency and that is customarily used and accepted as a medium of exchange in the country of issuance.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.definition: (G) "Payment instrument" means a check, draft, money order, travelers check, or other instrument or order for the transmission or payment of money, sold to one or more persons, whether or not that instrument or order is negotiable. "Payment instrument" does not include an instrument that is redeemable by the issuer in merchandise or service, a credit card voucher, or a letter of credit.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.definition: (H) "Proceeds" means property acquired or derived directly or indirectly from, produced through, realized through, or caused by an act or omission and includes property of any kind.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.definition: (I) "Property" means anything of value and includes an interest in property, including a benefit, privilege, claim, or right with respect to anything of value, whether real or personal, tangible or intangible.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.definition: (J) "Purposely" has the same meaning as in section 2901.22 of the Revised Code.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.definition: (K) "Structure a transaction" means dividing a transaction that otherwise would be reportable under this chapter into two or more transactions that, if considered separately, would not be reportable.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.definition: (L) "Transaction" includes a purchase, sale, trade, loan, pledge, investment, gift, transfer, transmission, delivery, deposit, withdrawal, payment, transfer between accounts, exchange of currency, extension of credit, purchase or sale of a payment instrument, use of a safe deposit box, or any other acquisition or disposition of property.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.definition: (M) "Transmitting money" includes the transmission of money by any means, including transmissions within the United States or to or from locations outside the United States by payment instrument, wire, facsimile or electronic transfer, or courier.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.definition: (N) "Travelers check" means an instrument identified as a travelers check on its face or commonly recognized as a travelers check and issued in a money multiple of United States or foreign currency with a provision for a specimen signature of the purchaser to be completed at the time of purchase and a countersignature of the purchaser to be completed at the time of negotiation.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.

glossary.definition: (O) "Unlawful activity" means an act that is a criminal offense in the state in which the act is committed and, if the act is committed in a state other than this state, would be a criminal offense if committed in this state.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 1315.51 to 1315.55 of the Revised Code, unless the context otherwise requires:
glossary.source_title: Section 1315.51 - Transaction reporting, money laundering definitions.
